english.notes:
(i) Suspicious premises are premises in which the inspector has reasonable cause to suspect that an offence under section 3B or section 7(4) has been committed.
(ii) This section does not give an inspector the power to enter or inspect all premises. Section 9(9) states:
Nothing in this section shall authorise any inspector to enter or inspect the premises, not being a shop, of a doctor, a dentist, a veterinary surgeon or a veterinary practitioner.other than that of a shop, of a doctor, a dentist, a veterinary surgeon or a veterinary practitioner.
